_comment: Declarative manifest for scripts/ai/lib/refactor_status.py. Carries EDITORIAL content (name/sub/note/decision/unblocks/issues) so descriptions live in one editable place. STATUS is never stored here — it is always projected from ground truth (git log / activation events / freeze records / slice-claims / blocker_note) by the projector. Hand-editing a status field here would be pointless: the projector recomputes status and ignores any such field. See .agents/plans/aqos-refactor-status/SPEC.md.
